tail:
**Batch 104 authoring is complete:** 27 A-page items and 2 B-page items, with page bodies empty. I added explicit PL embedding and triangulation prerequisites and completed the finite-chain orientation proof. The item levels were recomputed from the full run dependency graph (levels 0–8); batch 104’s scheduling level 2 is a separate batch-level value.

Twenty-two items have current hash-bound `ready` records. Seven are escalated:

- `thm-haken-normal-essential-disk-existence`: the cited theorem’s proof is not supplied.
- `thm-jaco-tollefson-normal-essential-disk-vertex-existence`: the cited JT Corollary 6.4 proof was not recovered.
- `lem-meridian-disk-criterion-for-unknot-exterior`: the disk-to-smooth-unknot implication lacks a complete proof.
- `thm-haken-finite-box-search-correctness` and `thm-jaco-tollefson-vertex-search-correctness`: completeness depends on those existence results.
- `thm-normal-surface-unknot-algorithm-terminates-and-is-correct` and `thm-unknot-recognition-has-np-certificate`: correctness depends on the unresolved search and disk criteria.

The source history and exact affected claims are recorded in the [coverage file](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-104.coverage.json). All three full-text sources are fetch-verified, including [Rourke–Sanderson](https://webhomes.maths.ed.ac.uk/~v1ranick/papers/rsplx.pdf) for the PL conventions.

Checks passed: strict proof contracts **29/29**, proof layout **29 items / 85 steps / 0 defects**, and focused `depcheck` with **0 errors and warnings**. The full-run dependency command still reports **104 empty inventories and 34 stale labels in other batches**; none of batch 104’s items is among its errors, and it found no cycles or malformed dependencies.

The live autopilot run remains held at `1-scaffold` (42/109 covered) by shared owner blockers for units 31 and 56 and a malformed prerequisite in `def-based-string-link-and-labeled-link-peripheral-system`. These are outside batch 104’s write scope.

See the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-104.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-104.pages.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-104.proof-contracts.json).
